staffWorkflow.title: How staff work across Southfield Group
staffWorkflow.subtitle: From joining to payslip · one staff list, either company · each step shows where your data stands today

join.title: Join the group
join.body: Add the person once to Southfield Group: designation (required for everyone), the company that issues the payslip, pay group, salary or day rate, KYC and WhatsApp number.

plan.title: Plan the week
plan.body: Each day's slot names the company, place, job and shift. The day's duty decides which company the day belongs to.

mark.title: Mark attendance
mark.body: One mark per person per day, with hours and overtime hours. Leave and advances are asked for in the staff app and decided by someone else.

hours.title: Days follow the company
hours.body: Days worked for the other company are visible by person, for the month-end cross-charge. The payslip stays with one company.

cash.title: Cash given
cash.body: Advances and other cash to staff are entered when paid, under the daily cash limit, and recovered when payroll is approved.

pay.title: Month-end payroll
pay.body: One salary sheet per payslip company, worked out by the server. The person who prepares it cannot approve it; approval posts it to the books and sends payslip-ready messages without amounts.

staffWorkflow.legalTitle: The one legal point to settle
staffWorkflow.legalBody: Everyone belongs to Southfield Group in the app, but the group is not a company, so each person's payslip, PF, ESI and wage register come from one company. Confirm the treatment with your CA; PF and ESI stay off until then.
